# Chrome DevTools

Skills that teach agents to work with Chrome DevTools. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp), at commit `a878bca`.

Reliable automation, in-depth debugging, and performance analysis in Chrome using Chrome DevTools and Puppeteer

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Chrome DevTools**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Chrome DevTools**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install chrome-devtools-mcp@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

7 skills: `a11y-debugging`, `chrome-devtools`, `chrome-devtools-cli`, `cookie-debugging`, `debug-optimize-lcp`, `memory-leak-debugging`, `troubleshooting`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

## Docs

- Vendor repository: https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp
